extraction.Name: Zoe Utterback
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not want the patent and knew nothing about it until it came to me. Did you make any protest about this patent? No.
extraction.Buyer: I sold it to my husband for a residence in Belvidere and $3000.00 in cash
extraction.Fee Patent Date: some time ago ten years perhaps
extraction.Occupation/Income: No one, my husband supports me
extraction.NOTES: Received patent in Belvidere, I think by mail; figures she got about $4400.00 in all for the land; still has property in Belvidere and it is clear; husband still owns the land; no liens against the land; not in good health. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on June 4, 1929. Witness to mark: Zoe Utterback (signed with mark).
